acceptance: `gh api repos/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-datagen/environments/review/secrets` lists the 8 secrets; `gh api .../rulesets` shows the main ruleset with review-gate restricted to the App.
PR #3 receives an App-posted review-verdict and a review-gate status; a PR with an open finding is blocked from merging (shown on a real PR).
The hourly review-gate and review-verdict runs on main are green.
A `v0.1.0` tag publishes all 8 wheels and the sdist to PyPI through Trusted Publishing; `pip install benchbox-datagen==0.1.0` works on Linux, macOS and Windows.

context: Owner decisions 2026-11-27 (dialog): (1) TPC-DS sub-scale: carry the 72-line tpcgen-rs #677 patch (pin tpcdsgen to a BenchBox-dev/tpcgen-rs commit = v4.0.0 + #677), delete own dsgen/ generators, return to crates.io when released. (2) Upstream-gap rule: no divergent fork; a carried patch only if <= ~200 changed lines, submitted upstream, pinned by commit, listed in README with its upstream PR; anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first. (3) TPC-DS refresh sets: keep own code in its own PR, finish SF 100 parity, offer upstream; required before C removal, not before the TPC cutover. (4) Acceptance: a metric passes inside legacy min-max or the 99.9% prediction interval from 5 legacy seeds; boundary quantiles on low-cardinality columns by rank. (5) Empty queries: must return rows on every seed where legacy does on every seed; where legacy is sometimes empty, the library may be empty on no more seeds than legacy. (6) SSB row counts follow the SSB specification (part = 200,000 x floor(1 + log2 SF), date = 2,556). (7) Oracle defects: qgen seed 0 for Q7/Q12 raises a clear error; the 13 nondeterministic dsqgen cases are excluded only with recorded proof and the library is deterministic for them. (8) Licensing: proceed; ship the TPC legal notice in wheels, templates and tpcds.idx stay in BenchBox, record the position in the licensing doc. (9) Until the review gate posts its first verdict, library PRs may merge with green CI plus an independent reviewer agent reporting no Critical/High/Medium findings; afterwards the gate is required. (10) BenchBox native-datagen extra may be developed and CI-tested against wheels built from a pinned library commit; the BenchBox PR adding the extra merges only after the PyPI release exists. (11) Lock-waiter kills: investigate and report only; no kill-policy change. Decision (9) lifts the merge hold in the interim; the owner setup steps remain required, and the red review runs on main continue until then.
description:
## Problem
Owner decided (2026-11-26) that library PRs must pass the review bot and essential CI. PR #2 wired the theseus callers, but on 2026-11-27 the `review` environment has 0 secrets, no ruleset protects `main`, and App installation is unconfirmed. Consequences: `review-gate`/`review-verdict` fail on every PR and hourly on main (red runs); nothing is required to merge; library PRs #3-#7 are held; no release can be published, so BenchBox cannot pin the library.

## Change
Owner actions: (1) install the benchbox-review App on BenchBox-dev/benchbox-datagen; (2) add to environment `review` (deployment branch main) the secrets REVIEW_APP_ID, REVIEW_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, REVIEW_GATEWAY_TOKEN, REVIEW_GATEWAY_URL, TS_OAUTH_CI_CLIENT_ID, TS_OAUTH_CI_SECRET, TYPESAFE_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY; (3) ruleset on main requiring the CI checks, `review pins`, and the `review-gate` status with the App as expected source; (4) allow-list the pinned theseus workflows and their actions; (5) PyPI pending Trusted Publisher (repo BenchBox-dev/benchbox-datagen, workflow wheels.yml, environment pypi). Agent actions after that: add the tag-triggered publish job to wheels.yml (OIDC, no token), `/review` PR #3, and verify the gate end to end.

## Decision gates
- Owner-only: steps 1-5 (settings, secrets). An agent must not create secrets, rulesets or App installations.
- If the gate cannot reach the gateway from this repository (tailnet tag), stop and report rather than weakening the policy.
- Interim merges by CI plus agent review are NOT authorised; ask the owner if the hold must be lifted for a named PR.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, make agent-write-preflight); the primary clone is read-only.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run; never bypass or signal the lock, and never kill processes by name pattern (pkill -f); stop only PIDs you started.
- Commits as the configured human identity; no agent attribution.
- No carried or own reimplementation of upstream code without the owner decision recorded in datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy.
- A choice between a small and a large implementation path goes to the owner with sizes before work starts.
- Report only results that were observed; name anything not run.
